subject: Rate-flex options and short-term quota uplift
messages:
From: Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@novagrid.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Bell <marcus@novagrid.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Short-term quota uplift + pricing flex?

Laura —

Quick note from the launch planning desk: our November promotion is expected to push traffic ~6x for a 10 day window (peak days Nov 18–27). We need options for a temporary quota increase (roughly additional 1.8M tokens/day peak) and clarity on overrun billing. Procurement asked if there are (a) short-lived top-up credits we can buy up front, (b) temporary rate-ladder discounts if we convert some spend to a short committed tranche, or (c) a capped overrun price for one-off spikes.

Attached our PO template for internal procurement to speed the process. Can you outline 2–3 approaches and any quick approval path? We are on a tight timeline — would like to finalize commercial terms by COB 2026-11-03.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Reynolds
Head of Growth, Novagrid
claire.reynolds@novagrid.ai

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@novagrid.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term quota uplift + pricing flex?

Claire —

Appreciate the heads-up. Below are three pragmatic options we often use for short windows like yours; I’ve included quick pros/cons and a target timeline so you can pick the fastest path. I attached a short rate-card export with worked examples (redwood-rate-card-q4.xlsx).

1) Ephemeral top-up (fastest) — "Top-up Pack":
   - What: Prepay for a fixed token pack to be consumed within a 30-day window.
   - Example: 5M additional tokens at $0.75 / 1k tokens (prepaid).
   - Pros: Fast to approve, invoiced up front, no post-facto paperwork.
   - Cons: No refunds; pricing is slightly above committed rates.

2) Provisional headroom (soft-commit) — "Soft-Commit Ladder":
   - What: Temporary uplift converted to a short-term commit for 3 months with a blended discount.
   - Example: Convert 30% of uplift into a 3-month commit; discount tier 12–18% depending on total commit.
   - Pros: Lower unit cost, partial commitment converts to future credit.
   - Cons: Requires PO and minimal sign-off from procurement.

3) Capped overrun (safety cap) — "Overrun Cap Addendum":
   - What: Keep your current commit; add a capped per-token overrun rate for the launch window.
   - Example: Overrun cap at $0.95 / 1k tokens for the 10-day window, with a hard cap of $X on total overrun invoice.
   - Pros: Predictability for budget; minimal change to contract language.
   - Cons: Requires legal sign-off; slightly slower execution.

Recommended path for Novagrid given the timeline: Ephemeral top-up to cover immediate spikes + Soft-Commit Ladder for the following quarter to capture a discount and convert part of spend into a cheaper committed tranche.

Next steps: if you confirm the preferred option I’ll loop in Ben (pricing lead) for a concession check and Karhtik for quick approval if we need to add a short addendum. We can generate a one-page addendum for DocuSign within 24 hours for the top-up path. HubSpot ref: HS-90823.

Regards,
Laura Bennett | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Attachments: redwood-rate-card-q4.xlsx

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-11-01T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term quota uplift + pricing flex? — suggested concession

Quick note from pricing: Laura’s recommended combo is sensible. For Novagrid we can offer the following concession structure for a first-time short-window top-up:

- One-off ephemeral top-up: 5M tokens at $0.70 / 1k tokens (5% reduction from standard top-up).
- Soft-commit conversion incentive: if Novagrid converts >=30% of the top-up into a 3-month reserved commit within 30 days, we retro-apply a 10% credit to the initial top-up invoice (applied as account credit).
- Overrun cap: we can offer a capped overrun addendum on request, but legal needs 48 hours for that paper.

Limits: Discount window limited to this promo; maximum one-off discount for ad-hoc top-ups capped at 18% total (need Karhtik sign-off above that).

I’ll prepare a short internal approval note and mark it for fast-track review. Laura — if you confirm Novagrid wants the 5M top-up at $0.70, I’ll flag finance for PO acceptance and prepare the invoice flow.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Pricing Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
